problems.q: A retiring employee receives an annual pension proportional to the square root of the number of years of his service. Had he served $a$ years more, his pension would have been $p$ dollars greater, whereas had he served $b$ years more $(b\ne a)$, his pension would have been $q$ dollars greater than the original annual pension. Find his annual pension in terms of $a,b,p$ and $q$.
